description: Create auto-escaping tagged template literal html utility and migrate all innerHTML usages in ajun-runtime and project-progress-board frontends
steps: Create `apps/ajun-runtime/frontend/src/html.ts` with: (1) a tagged template literal function `html` that auto-escapes interpolated values via the existing escapeHtml logic, (2) a `raw()` wrapper function that marks a string as pre-sanitized (returns object with __html_raw symbol), (3) the html tag checks for raw-marked values and passes them through, all others get escaped. Export html, raw, and escapeHtml.

Update `apps/ajun-runtime/frontend/src/app.ts`: import { html, raw, escapeHtml } from './html.js'. Remove the local escapeHtml function. Replace all innerHTML assignments that use template literals with escapeHtml calls to use the html tagged template instead. For example: `node.innerHTML = html`
${label}
``; For pre-sanitized HTML fragments (like SVG icons or previously-escaped content), wrap in raw().
Update `apps/ajun-runtime/frontend/src/app-access-views.ts`: import html and raw from './html.js', receive them from the factory params or import directly. Migrate innerHTML usages.
Update `apps/ajun-runtime/frontend/src/task-timeline-view.ts`: replace defaultEscapeHtml with the html utility or keep escapeHtml from html.ts.
Create `apps/ajun-runtime/test/html-template.test.js` testing: auto-escape of <script> tags, raw() bypass, nested templates, null/undefined handling.
Run `npm run build:frontend --workspace=ajun-runtime` to compile and update public/*.js files.

Also create a similar utility for project-progress-board: `apps/project-progress-board/frontend/src/html.ts` and migrate apps/project-progress-board/frontend/src/app.ts to use it. Then build frontend.
acceptance_criteria: html.ts exists in ajun-runtime/frontend/src/ with html tagged template, raw() function, and escapeHtml export
All innerHTML usages in ajun-runtime frontend files use the html tagged template (no more manual escapeHtml + template literal pattern)
raw() is used for pre-sanitized content only
Test file apps/ajun-runtime/test/html-template.test.js passes with meaningful coverage of escaping behavior
verification: npm run build:frontend --workspace=ajun-runtime && git diff --stat apps/ajun-runtime/public/
findings: The check:architecture script has a pre-existing failure (repository-catalog.json area issue) unrelated to this feature. npm run check --workspace=ajun-runtime passes successfully (tsc + frontend build + typescript-ratio gate). All 21 tests in html-template.test.js pass. The escapeHtml function is still exported from html.ts for use in helper functions that receive it as a parameter (renderAcceptanceDetail, renderAttentionDetail, renderTechnicalDetails).
